title: Ashbury Rewards Tier Recognition: Goodwill Waiver on Stay Credit Reversals
content:
Ashbury Rewards upper-tier members who stay often have part of a stay credit reversal waived when a folio correction takes back points.

## Waiver

| Tier | Net elite night credits in the twelve months | Goodwill waiver |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 50 or more | First 2000 points of the reversal |
| Platinum Elite, Titanium Elite or Ambassador Elite | 25 to 49 | First 1000 points of the reversal |
| Gold Elite | 25 or more | First 1000 points of the reversal |
| Gold Elite or higher | 24 or fewer | No goodwill waiver |
| Member, Silver Elite | any | No goodwill waiver |

In words: a member at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or higher whose elite night credits posted in the twelve months before the handling date, less the night credits reversed in those months, are at least fifty has the first two thousand points of the reduced reversal waived; a member at Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite with at least twenty-five such night credits, or at Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite or higher with twenty-five to forty-nine, has the first one thousand points waived; any other member has no goodwill waiver. The waiver is taken off the points to be reversed and never takes them below zero.

The twelve months before the handling date are the transactions posted after the same day number twelve months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

## Cases (hypothetical members)

| Tier | Net night credits | Points to be reversed before the waiver | Waiver | Points reversed after the waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Titanium Elite | 50 | 3400 | 2000 | 1400 |
| Gold Elite | 30 | 3400 | 1000 | 2400 |
| Gold Elite | 60 | 3400 | 1000 | 2400 |
| Platinum Elite | 40 | 700 | 1000 | 0 |
| Silver Elite | 70 | 3400 | none | 3400 |
